digest.component_or_area: ticket plan review and clarity assessment
propositions: Six proposed deterministic clarity criteria were tested against a corpus of 574 closed tickets with signed plan-review attestation; all six showed historical false positives in valid accepted tickets.
Literal section-heading requirements (Approach, Scope) are unsound; valid plans use semantic aliases and compact execution in What/AC instead of required headings.
Per-AC proof-coverage markers and placeholder-lexicon detectors cannot distinguish resolved specifications from deferred choices; both need semantic normalizers to avoid false rejection.
Edit-set and file_impact requirements must exempt read-only analysis, operational, and external-attestation work; ticket 0730-6ceb-88c3-430c is closed/valid with empty file_impact.
AC conjunction counts cannot distinguish atomic matrices from vague compounds; ticket 090f-4f7c-44ba-49ae bundles coherent invariants.
Testing-section shape requirements must apply only after semantic applicability rules; mechanical migrations have no user-facing behavior and do not require failure-scenario taxonomy.
